---
title: "Pivot between wide and long"
---

Count the penguins per species and study year, with one column per year, then
stack the year columns into one row per species and year.
[`penguins`](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#penguins) has size
measurements for 344 penguins near Palmer Station, Antarctica, from 2007 to
2009 (Gorman et al., 2014).

{{< include pages/_pivot.md >}}

- `count()` gives one row per species and year, with the count in `n`.
- `pivot_wider()` makes one column for each value of `year`, adds the `n_`
  prefix, and fills the columns from `n`. The columns it doesn't use, here
  `species`, identify the output rows.
- `pivot_longer()` stacks the columns that `starts_with('n_')` selects. Each
  column name, without the `n_` prefix, goes into `year`, and each value goes
  into `penguins`.
- `year` holds strings, because the values come from column names.

Reference: [tidyr](../reference/tidyr.qmd#pivoting) ·
[Selecting columns](../reference/tidyselect.qmd#selectors)
